title: Make the fixed-tick runtime the sole public execution path
requires: Production runtime/toolchain plus applicable physical GPU; cross-platform build evidence
scope: Replace the legacy-default/profile split with one production simulation architecture. Remove legacy scheduler dispatch and execution-profile selection from runtime, public registry/generated API and shipping configurations; preserve historical evidence separately. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-SINGLE-EXECUTION-PATH.md.
acceptance: Normal public simulation creation and stepping execute the complete fixed-tick path on every applicable adapter without an extension/profile request, mode flag, environment variable or build-time legacy choice.

Delete unreachable legacy production scheduler/glue and selector branches; shared reusable physics helpers remain only where used. Source/symbol and public execution checks prove a single schedule for all supported domains, mixed scenes, headless, diagnostics and recovery.

Keep the create/resources/commands/submit/output application model; publish explicit API/ABI version migration when incompatible timestep/substep or layout semantics require it, and reject incompatible old requests instead of silently changing their meaning.

Update machine-readable contract negotiation, generated bindings/reference artifacts, capability/validation logic and installed C/C++ consumer tests together. A historical evidence profile identifier must not remain a selectable production engine.

Retain all currently supported domain/interaction capabilities and fixed numeric gates; unsupported-hardware reporting cannot mask a missing native binding. Cross-platform builds and meaningful public production tests pass.
